description:
RateLimitInfo — Caller's rate limit status on this Exchange.
 Modeled after IETF RateLimit header fields (RFC 9110 §15.5.30)
 and Shutterstock's rate limit response pattern.

limit.description: Maximum requests allowed in the current window.

remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current window.

reset_at.description: When the current window resets (UTC). After this time, `remaining` resets to `limit`.

window.description: Duration of the rate limit window (e.g. 60s = per-minute limit).

title: Rate Limit Info
